items.title: File Widerspruch against GdB decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats Widerspruch erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Versorgungsamt Beispielfeld, Am Versorgungsamt 1, 49074 Musterosna.
items.computation: Letter is dated and posted 27.05.2026 (Wednesday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is given, so posting day = 27.05.2026. This is a social-law body (Feststellungen nach SGB IX, procedure governed by SGB X), so the 4-day delivery fiction (§37 Abs.2 SGB X) applies but the delivery day does NOT shift even if it falls on a weekend or holiday (unlike the Finanzamt rule). Counting 4 calendar days from 27.05.2026: 28.05, 29.05, 30.05, 31.05.2026 → deemed delivered Sunday 31.05.2026 (no shift). The one-month Widerspruch period (§84 SGG analogy / §26 SGB X with §§187,188 BGB) runs from this delivery date and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number; since June has only 30 days, it ends on the last day of June: 30.06.2026 (Tuesday, not a holiday in NRW), so the deadline does not need to move further under §26 Abs.3 SGB X.
